# Arkhe Engine

<p class="arkhe-project__type">2D Engine and Editor</p>

<p class="arkhe-project__status">Active development · private repository</p>

## Overview

Arkhe Engine is a 2D engine and editor built in C++ around OpenGL. The project lets me work on engine software architecture, graphics rendering, and the design of editing tools.

At a high level, the project distinguishes responsibilities related to engine execution from those specific to the editing environment. This page presents the project’s public direction without documenting its complete architecture.

## Technologies

<p class="arkhe-project__technologies"><span>Core technologies&nbsp;:</span> C++ · OpenGL · SDL2 · ImGui · CMake · Git</p>

## Main capabilities

::: {.arkhe-feature-list}

### 2D engine and OpenGL rendering

The engine is designed for 2D projects and relies on OpenGL for graphics rendering.

### Dedicated editor and tools

The editing environment brings together tools for building and organizing projects.

### Project management

The project includes project management to structure work between the editor and the runtime.

### Modular organization and build

The project is organized in modules and uses CMake for its build system.

:::

## Selected technical choices

One direction of the project is to separate code required for engine execution from tools specific to the editor. This separation helps limit the editor environment’s dependencies in the runtime.

CMake supports the project’s modular organization and build system without exposing the engine’s internal mechanisms.

## Project status

Arkhe is under active development and its repository remains private. This page gives an overview of the work while keeping the level of detail appropriate for a professional portfolio.
